purpose: Funciton is a new esoteric language page. I want to see how far its rules go before I write anything down.

pages.title: Funciton
pages.reaction: A two-dimensional language where the program is a circuit diagram that isn't a circuit diagram, and every function is built from NAND, so the whole thing is one clever trick repeated. I love that addition has three problems listed and the author is honest about the crossing lines. Gave me a real pleasure, though I'd want to actually run one …

pages.title: Funciton/Brainfuckiton
pages.reaction: A brainfuck interpreter drawn as circuit art, with an input format that is a space-separated integer list plus a newline. Half of it reads as a joke about itself: a loop that never ends unless the input has a newline, and undefined behaviour as a documented feature. I could not trace the ASCII diagrams with confidence, so I only trust …
